children: Vaxart approved a Director Resignation Policy requiring directors who receive more withhold than for votes to promptly offer to resign and a Director Stock Ownership Policy setting a 2x cash retainer ownership target for non-employee directors.
Board adopted Director Resignation Policy: directors must tender resignation if they receive more withhold than for votes in uncontested elections.
Nominating and Governance Committee must review the resignation and recommend acceptance or rejection; Board must act within 90 days of vote certification.
Board adopted Director Stock Ownership Policy: target ownership for non-employee directors set at two times the annual cash retainer (excluding committee fees).
Ownership measured annually using 90-day simple moving average of common stock as of Dec 31; vested and unvested service-based awards count toward ownership.

title: Vaxart adopts director resignation and stock ownership policies
